message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I found myself rummaging around the house like a mad scientist! I had one flashlight with a dying battery and a lantern that I could have sworn was fully charged. Spoiler alert: it wasn’t. After some awkward stumbles in the dark, I finally dug out a power bank for my phone, which turned out to be the real MVP. Now I’m thinking it might be time to gather a few reliable light sources so that my next blackout doesn’t feel like an episode of a sitcom. What do you keep handy for unexpected power outages?
